create_flow: create a Flow with named inputs and define transitions that compute outputs from those inputs
build_flow_tape: build a computation tape from a Flow by specifying output names and tracing dependencies
run_flow: run a Flow by passing input arguments and specifying output names to retrieve results
create_fixed_output_flow: create a FixedOutputFlow that caches a precomputed tape for repeated execution with fixed outputs
create_auto_forward: create an AutoForward wrapper that provides a default-output forward method on a Flow
